# RemoveFirst

Removes the first element of an array.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
RemoveFirst(items)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array | The array to remove from, which is left unchanged. Null is read as the empty array; any other type that is not an array is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Array. A new array holding every element of items but the first, in order; the empty array when items is empty or null. Never null.

## Example

`RemoveFirst([1, 2, 3])` returns `[2, 3]`.
